'''Chiller bars''' were components used in [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]]. The chiller bars cooled the surrounding area, even in harsh [[Desert/Legends|desert]] environments, allowing condensation to form on its surface which was then collected by the vaporator.<ref name="EGWT" />
